criteria.criterion: ccmorph run -i, ccmorph config and ccmorph inspect on a closed or piped stdin (no tty) exit with a named cause ("needs a terminal") and a non-zero status; none waits forever, and run -i does not print Cancelled and then hang.
criteria.evidence: The guard lives in uiTheme.search (cli/ui.go): `if !pickerHasTerminal() { t.refuseNoTerminal(rows, true); return "", 2 }` runs before the fzf launch, so with no terminal the picker is NOT launched and no answer is taken — the earlier answer-only run (which accepted a fake's choice) is gone. pickerHasTerminal is `isTTY(0) || ttyUsable()` (/dev/tty opens). Real commands, 2026-11-21, full transcript in .hive/review-fix.txt: an isolated HOME with one profile (gw) and an fzf that WOULD answer (prints the first row, records its launch); `ccmorph run -i`, `ccmorph config`, `ccmorph inspect` and `ccmorph inspect -i`, each `</dev/null` in a session with no controlling terminal, printed `ccmorph: selection needs a terminal; pass the value directly` plus the rows `gw	gw	API key	https://gateway.invalid`, exited rc=1, and never launched the fixture (fzf launched: no for all four). Regression: `CCMORPH_TEST_FILTER=test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725 zsh tests/ccmorph_test.zsh` -> `PASS: test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725`, `All 1 tests passed`; the test now also fails if the fzf fixture's pid file is ever written, so 'skip the picker' is pinned. Go: `go test ./cli/ -run TestSearchPickerWithoutTerminal -count=1 -v` -> 4 subtests PASS (fixtures that would answer, wait 30 s, fail like fzf, or answer Esc) and `ok github.com/akleizor/ccmorph/cli`; every run is rc 2 with the exact message, the rows, no `Cancelled`, and the invocation marker absent. Full launch suite on the gate: `All 84 tests passed`.

criteria.criterion: One shared no-tty guard covers the pickers behind all three verbs (not one check per entry point).
criteria.evidence: The single guard is in uiTheme.search in cli/ui.go, which every profile and value picker walks through: `grep -n 'uiSelect("search"' cli/menus.go` -> `109: v, rc := uiSelect("search", "Profile", strings.Join(rows, "\n"), "all")` and `189: return uiSelect("search", prompt, rows, display)`; uiSelect dispatches to t.search. `grep -rn 'exec.Command(fzf' --include=*.go . | grep -v _test.go` -> only `cli/ui.go:860: cmd := exec.Command(fzf, args...)`; `grep -rn fzf lib/ | wc -l` -> `0`. The guard is one `if !pickerHasTerminal()` at cli/ui.go:863, above that launch. The zsh regression drives run -i, config, inspect and inspect -i through it.

criteria.criterion: A zsh-suite regression test runs each verb under </dev/null inside a timeout: it fails on today's main (hang) and passes after; interactive picker behaviour with a tty is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Fails on main, passes after. Main reproduction with this branch's final test file: `git clone --no-hardlinks . $TMPDIR/ccm725-main4`, `git checkout origin/main -- cli/ui.go` (main 152b082), copy tests/ccmorph_test.zsh, `make shim`, then the filtered zsh run printed `ccmorph run -i with no terminal waited forever instead of refusing`, the same for `config`, `inspect` and `inspect -i`, then `FAIL: test_pickers_refuse_by_name_without_a_terminal_issue_725`, `1 of 1 tests failed` (transcript in .hive/review-fix.txt). On this branch the same command prints PASS. Interactive unchanged: the tty branch in uiTheme.search is the pre-issue launch untouched (`cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr; out, err := cmd.Output()`, no clock), entered when isTTY(0) or /dev/tty opens; a pty transcript in .hive/review-fix.txt shows `ccmorph _ui select search Profile` under a terminal painting the list, launching the fixture (`fzf launched: yes`) and returning `gw` rc=0. Fourteen zsh picker tests that answer a person's picker now re-enter the suite in a pty child (`_ccm_terminal_tests` + `_ccm_run_test_under_a_terminal` in tests/ccmorph_test.zsh) and all pass on the gate (`All 84 tests passed`), including test_set_model_interactively_saves_the_chosen_id, test_menu_returns_a_bare_model_id, test_launch_interactive_resolves_a_real_model and test_search_picker_on_an_old_fzf_never_hides_rows_silently_issue_278.
